money_market.source: WIBOR and POLSTR fixings of 30 Dec 2025 (GPW Benchmark annual files, read for historical fixings only); repo from the Treasury BondSpot Poland session of 30 Dec 2025. Funding = special repo 3.70%.

irs.source: PLN IRS vs 6M WIBOR of 22 Dec 2025 (Erste daily) - the latest verifiable quote before the cut-off; no 30 Dec close was found. Between 22 and 30 Dec POLGB yields fell 3-7bp, so ASW computed against this curve are likely understated by roughly that much if swaps moved in line. Interpolated with PCHIP through 6M WIBOR (30 Dec); beyond 10Y extrapolated.
irs.short_source: PLN IRS of 22 Dec 2025 (latest verifiable), WIBOR fixings 30 Dec 2025

curve.source: NSS zero curve fitted to BondSpot closing fixings of 30 Dec 2025; front end anchored at a 3M zero of 3.25% (OK0426 3.28%, DS0726 3.22%, PS1026 3.28%; POLSTR 3.53%).

portfolio_meta._source: GPW Benchmark 'Portfele obligacji' communique for the periodic change of 30 Dec 2025 (holdings as of 22 Dec 2025). PDF metadata shows regeneration on 7 Jan 2026; units reconciled line-by-line with the 26 Nov 2025 file plus MoF auctions/switches/OB operations to 23 Dec 2025, so content reflects pre-cut-off information only.
